about_pullquote: We fix boilers the way we'd want ours fixed—honestly, fairly, and fast.
about_para_1: Balsall Plumbing and Heating Ltd has been serving Coventry and the surrounding Midlands for 18 years. Founded on the principle that emergency heating repairs shouldn't leave you out of pocket, we've built a reputation for turning up on time, diagnosing faults correctly, and charging fair prices. Our team are all Gas Safe Registered and trained to the latest heating standards.
about_para_2: Homeowners and landlords in Balsall Common trust us because we answer the phone, we show up when we say we will, and we explain what's wrong before we start work. We're not here to upsell unnecessary parts—our goal is to get your heat back on and keep your bills reasonable. Many of our customers have used us for 10+ years and refer their friends and family.
reviews_heading: What Coventry Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Boiler died on Boxing Day—absolute nightmare. Called Balsall at 10am and Dave was at the house by 11:30. He diagnosed a faulty pump, had a spare in the van, and we had heating again by lunchtime. Brilliant service, fair price, and he didn't patronise me when explaining what went wrong. Will definitely call again.
reviews.author: Mike T.

reviews.text: Had my boiler serviced before winter. The engineer was thorough, professional, and explained everything clearly. He spotted a small valve issue that could have become a bigger problem. Cost was reasonable and the work was guaranteed. Very impressed.
reviews.author: Susan K.

reviews.text: Called for a radiator replacement. No high-pressure sales pitch, just a straightforward quote and a timely installation. The new radiator was fitted properly and the system was balanced. Heating is now even throughout the house. Friendly and efficient—exactly what you want from a local tradesman.
reviews.author: James P.
